title: Execution of an algebraic circuit
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $x$ assign an element of $R$ to each of $n$ input variables, and let $g_1,\ldots,g_m$ be an ordered list of algebraic gates. Running the list produces, in order, the values of each gate, with each gate evaluated using the input assignment and the values of all earlier gates.
